title: Plant Operations Director
text:
**Your experience matters**

**Raleigh General Hospital** is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As a **Plant Operations Director** joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

**More about our team**

Our Plant Operations team plays a vital role in supporting patient care and hospital operations by maintaining the facilities, infrastructure, critical systems, and essential utilities that keep our hospital running safely and efficiently around the clock. In this dynamic, fast-paced healthcare environment, team members collaborate across clinical, administrative, and support departments to ensure operational reliability, maintain regulatory compliance, oversee facility improvements, and support the hospital's evolving needs.

Success in this role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, technical expertise, and a commitment to operational excellence, ensuring a safe, reliable, and well-maintained environment that supports our staff, patients, and visitors.

**How you’ll contribute**

As the **Plant Operations Director** you will excel in this role by:

* Strategic Leadership & Organizational Alignment: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant operations, ensuring departmental goals, initiatives, and resources align with the hospital's mission, vision, and organizational priorities.
* Plant Operations & Facilities Management: Direct and oversee daily plant operations, facilities maintenance, engineering services, building systems, and infrastructure to ensure safe, reliable, efficient, and uninterrupted hospital operations.
* Critical Infrastructure & Utility Management: Ensure the reliability, maintenance, and operational readiness of critical hospital systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, emergency power, medical gas systems, and other essential utilities.
* 24/7 Operational Readiness & Emergency Response: Ensure operational continuity through effective preventive maintenance, emergency preparedness, contingency planning, and timely response to equipment failures, utility disruptions, and other critical situations that may impact patient care.
* Capital Planning & Project Management: Lead long-term infrastructure planning, capital improvement initiatives, construction projects, renovations, and facility upgrades while managing project budgets, timelines, resources, and minimizing disruptions to hospital operations.
* Financial & Resource Management: Develop, manage, and monitor departmental budgets, staffing resources, operating expenditures, and capital investments while identifying opportunities for cost containment, resource optimization, and improved operational efficiency.
* Leadership & Workforce Development: Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team through effective workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, ongoing training, and succession planning while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Regulatory Compliance, Life Safety & Risk Management: Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, building codes, life safety requirements, environmental standards, and organizational policies while maintaining survey readiness and proactively mitigating operational risks.
* Performance Management & Continuous Improvement: Establish and monitor key performance indicators, evaluate departmental performance, coordinate internal and external audits, and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality, reliability, productivity, and operational effectiveness.
* Executive & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with executive leadership, clinical departments, physicians, support services, vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders to address operational priorities, support patient safety, maintain an exceptional healthcare environment, and advance the hospital's strategic objectives.

**Why join us**

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.
* **Financial Protection & PTO**: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.
* **Financial & Career Growth**: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.
* **Employee Well-being**: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs)
* **Professional Development**: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.
* Significant progressive leadership experience in plant operations, facilities management, engineering, or infrastructure operations, preferably within a large, complex hospital or healthcare environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing large-scale facilities, critical infrastructure, building systems, utilities, preventive maintenance programs, and 24/7 operational environments.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, life safety codes, Environment of Care, emergency preparedness, and applicable safety and compliance standards.
* Proven financial management experience, including departmental budgeting, expense control, capital planning, resource allocation, and vendor and contract management.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and engage high-performing teams, manage workforce performance, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to oversee complex infrastructure projects, prioritize competing demands, and drive operational improvements.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with executive leadership, clinical teams, physicians, contractors, vendors, and other key stakeholders.

**More about Raleigh General Hospital**

**Raleigh General Hospital** cares for nearly 13,000 patients each year and treats more than 50,000 patients in its emergency room. We are accredited by the Joint Commission, the nationally recognized accrediting agency for healthcare facilities. Raleigh General Hospital also offers instructional programs for nursing students as well as numerous allied health student extern programs.

**EEOC Statement**

“Raleigh General Hospital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Raleigh General Hospital is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment in employment.”

 
We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.
